Jordan: Hi. I noticed you mentioned enjoying restaurants in your profile. Do you have a favorite cuisine?

Jordan: I'm a chef, so I appreciate most cuisines when executed well. Currently working at a French-influenced restaurant downtown.
Sophie: oh cool! what kind of stuff do you make
Jordan: Primarily tasting menus. Seven courses, seasonal ingredients. It requires significant precision.
Sophie: that sounds fancy haha
Jordan: It's demanding work. Not for everyone.
Sophie: i bet! do you get to be creative with it?
Jordan: Within parameters. The head chef sets the vision. I execute and occasionally contribute ideas when appropriate.
Sophie: gotcha. so like what do you do for fun outside of work?
Jordan: I read. Mostly non-fiction. Food history, technique manuals. Occasionally I visit other restaurants to study their approach.
Sophie: so... more food stuff? lol do you have hobbies outside of cooking
Jordan: I find the distinction between work and passion somewhat artificial. Cooking is what I do.
Sophie: fair enough i guess
Sophie: so are you looking for something serious on here or just seeing whats out there
Jordan: I prefer not to define expectations prematurely. I believe in letting things develop organically based on compatibility.
Sophie: ok that makes sense
Jordan: What about you?
Sophie: yeah same i guess! just looking to meet cool people and see what happens
Jordan: Reasonable.
